content.short: MermADA Minting is a Cardano NFT Minting Service run by Stake Pool TAILS operators MermADA & Fredrovicius.
content.description:
Looking to bring an NFT project to the Cardano Markets? MermADA Minting is a white label Cardano NFT Minting Service providing solutions customized to your brands needs. Our focus is our clients goals & helping bank the unbanked through the world of Cardano Defi. We aim to make navigating this ecosystem user friendly.

From 1:1 Cardano NFTs to small batches; bulk mints to vending machine sales; airdrops to token faucets MermADA Minting and Stake Pool TAILS can help get your Cardano NFT project minted!
